business: Site Manager: a venue website the owner runs by chatting with an AI agent
target: Owner-operators of independent cafés, bars and small restaurants in Sofia, Bulgaria, who run the place themselves and have no web person

segments.name: Small café or coffee bar owner (1 location, under 10 staff)
Bar or bistro owner with a kitchen (1 location, changing menu)

behaviours.name: Instagram is enough
behaviours.how: Posts specials on Instagram and Facebook; thinks nobody looks at websites any more.

behaviours.name: Has an outdated site
behaviours.how: Paid a freelancer or nephew for a site years ago; prices and hours on it are wrong; never touches it.

behaviours.name: Penny-pincher
behaviours.how: Questions every monthly fee; already pays for POS, accounting software and delivery-app commissions.

behaviours.name: Tech-curious early adopter
behaviours.how: Uses voice notes and ChatGPT already, likes trying new tools if they save time.

behaviours.name: Relies on Google and delivery apps
behaviours.how: Guests find them on Google Maps, Glovo or Wolt; menu lives there.

behaviours.name: Busy, delegates to a manager
behaviours.how: Too busy to decide on software; a manager or staff member handles small digital tasks.

behaviours.name: Trusts people, not apps
behaviours.how: Buys only from someone they know or who was recommended by another owner.

objections: Another monthly subscription? I already pay for too many.
Will the AI put a wrong price on my site?
My guests find me on Instagram and Google Maps, not on a website.
Who do I call when it breaks? Is there a real person in Bulgaria?
I don't want to learn a new app.
I already have a site; moving is a hassle.
Is my data and my domain mine if I stop paying?
habits: you open at 7:30 and do the supplier orders yourself
your menu board changes every day with the lunch special
you send voice notes on Viber all day
you check the Glovo tablet between orders
your daughter set up the Instagram account
you raised prices twice this year because of costs
